forbidden.body: This account is not allowed to use the app.

validation.amountFormat: Use the format 1234.56 (dot decimal, two places, may be negative).
validation.currencyInvalid: Currency must be a 3-letter ISO 4217 code.
validation.duplicateCategoryName: A category with this name already exists.
validation.categoryNotFound: That category no longer exists. Reload the page.
validation.incomeCategoryNotAllowed: Templates can only target expense categories.
validation.noActiveExpenseCategories: Create an active expense category first.

warnings.pastMonth: This month is not the current calendar month. Changes are allowed.
warnings.overspend: Actual tickets in this category are higher than the plan in your templates.
warnings.inactiveCategory: This category is inactive. It cannot be chosen for new entries.

empty.title: Create a month to start
empty.body: Nothing is created automatically. Pick a month and year to begin.

months.clone: Fixed and estimated lines are copied when the month is created. This month is independent after that.

summary.savingsHelp: Income minus actual spend minus money still reserved in fixed/estimated lines.

months.estimateHelp: Tickets do not reduce this number. Decrease it yourself when you want the reserve to drop.
months.passToActual: Move this commitment to actual spend. Estimates cannot be moved.

workspace.title: Month
workspace.noLines: No reserved lines cloned. Add actual spend or incomes below to start tracking this month.

home.noMonths: You have not created a month yet.

categories.title: Categories
categories.help: Categories are global across every month. Deactivating a category keeps it visible on past months but hides it from new entries.

templates.title: Fixed and estimated templates
templates.name: Name
templates.help: Templates are copied into a new month exactly once when that month is created. Inactive templates are not cloned.
templates.cloneCopy: Fixed and estimated lines are copied when the month is created. This month is independent after that.

settings.title: Profile settings
settings.help: Labels show two decimals. No currency conversion.

pwa.offlineNote: Data is online only. The app shell works offline once installed.
